description: Read an existing remote report, page or document to summarize it, answer questions, or reuse earlier work. Find its slug with find if needed. Without file, returns extracted plain text; with file, returns the original text of that relative file. Results include versionId and truncation information. Use get_site for filenames, edit to change one file, and export for binary files or a complete backup. Respects the artifact's text/AI access policy.

file.description: Relative text filename; omit for extracted document/page text.

max_chars.description: Maximum returned characters; increase if the response is truncated.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

slug.description: Artifact identifier returned by find/publish, or the slug in its /s/ URL. Not a local path.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

version_id.description: Exact version to read; omit for the current or fixed-share version.

name: artifact_site_read
title: Read a site
